World rule: centrepiece: replace 'a simple offset stone form' with 'one bold coloured sculpture (deep blue #315e83 ring or arch, about 3 m tall)'. Pale stone forms vanish on the pale square tiles. Also require coping darker than the square surface.
elements.fix: Within 48 parts, retain an approximately 4.5 m shallow circular basin and pale coping, replace the blades with one low offset stone form, and use three short tapered jets with small splash rings. Only recessed pool-light lenses should glow. / Make it a flush modern splash plaza. Lower the coping to 0.25 m with a broad seating edge on one side only. Darken the coping to #65717a with a light top lip, so the basin ring stands out from the tiles. Make the three water jets taller (1.8–2.2 m) with a white spray cap, so the fountain has a vertical read from the camera.

World rule: cafe (designDirection): add that from the 40° camera the roof must not be the dominant pale mass. Café roofs get a coloured parapet or awning and a rooftop sign so the front reads from above.
elements.fix: Shrink the roof's visual mass: drop the parapet, add a contrasting #39766f roof band, and put 2-3 rooftop units and a planter on the roof. Raise the glass shopfront to the full 3 m wall height on the two street-facing sides, using big #a9dadd panes with dark mullions. Run a #efb749 and white striped awning along the whole front. / Recolour the roof slab mid-grey #65717a and add a 0.6 m teal (#39766f) parapet band around its edge, so the building has a crisp coloured outline. Add a full-width striped awning over the shopfront (alternating teal and cream panels sloping down to the street at about 2.6 m), so the front reads 'café' from above. Replace the cup sign with a 1.4 m rooftop sign: a white cup with saucer and a dark brown coffee top, plus two tall steam swirls, standing on the front parapet. Make both parasols coloured (amber and teal). Pull the side hedges in to |x| ≤ 5.2.

problems: It renders as a long three-box saloon/estate (long bonnet, long rear) like an 80s Volvo, not the compact hatchback the bible and its own name call for
elements.fix: Shorten the overall length to about 3.6 m. Cut the bonnet to 0.8 m and slope it. Bring the cabin forward and end the car with a near-vertical rear hatch directly behind the rear wheels, with no boot overhang. Make the cabin tall relative to the body (about 45% of total height).
